def diagnostic_c(binding):
    """Replay only the frozen two-edit host lookup derivative; never emitted-C identity."""
    receipt = verify(pin(ROOT/'selfhost/build/phase90/table-accessor01/derivation.json'))
    assert receipt['sha256'] == 'f37c23e53db6c8421eb88e1aa735c267d5d00f22cf61ac1e64fc87d074364455'
    derivative = read(receipt['file'])
    assert derivative['kind'] == 'phase90-native-C-table-accessor-diagnostic'
    assert derivative['exactInverse'] and derivative['targetExecuted'] is False
    parent, output, recipe = [verify(derivative[key]) for key in ['parent', 'output', 'recipe']]
    assert parent == binding['c'] and parent['sha256'] == '81ca2837d2f274a23aeab7addf40cbef0e62a96a5ff7026c62a5112b1be0361e'
    assert output['sha256'] == 'a4cd3990972608fd71542c95cd1e6e20d77c1001ce65222d0c64bdea40bdd612'
    original = Path(parent['file']).read_bytes(); current = original
    assert len(derivative['edits']) == 2
    for edit in derivative['edits']:
        old, new = edit['old'].encode(), edit['new'].encode()
        assert current.count(old) == 1; current = current.replace(old, new, 1)
    assert current == Path(output['file']).read_bytes()
    for edit in reversed(derivative['edits']):
        old, new = edit['old'].encode(), edit['new'].encode()
        assert current.count(new) == 1; current = current.replace(new, old, 1)
    assert current == original
    binding['inputs'].extend([receipt, output, recipe])
    binding.update(compiledC=output, cDerivation=receipt, diagnosticOnly=True,
        originalProvenance=binding['provenance'], provenance='C-table-accessor-diagnostic')
    return output
